name: 자세히 읽기
prompt: Original Dog Atlas identity exploration. Flat illustrated graphic, confident consistent dark ink contours, gently hand-drawn character with precise clean silhouettes, restricted palette of warm off-white paper #e6e5d8, muted sage #aab8a2 and charcoal #293532. NO gold, NO metallic edges, NO bevel, NO gradients, NO photorealism, NO 3D, NO elaborate fur, NO scenery, NO sparkles, NO mascot big eyes. Subtle personality through shape, not decoration. Must harmonize with a dark forest-green #1c2624 website and sophisticated watercolor breed portraits. Real transparent background, no colored backdrop. Original design not copying another brand. Create ONE reusable UI action icon. Main object plus at most one small secondary cue; generic dog cue is allowed as explicitly requested by the user. Consistent thick-enough silhouette readable at 32 and 40 pixels. Square 1024x1024 canvas, 12–16% clear padding all around, evenly weighted, no words or labels.
